newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Spring bids higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Spring bids higher.

text.p: Dark Northern Spring wheat prices rose in line with sharp gains in MGE spring wheat futures, dealers said. Soft white wheat also posted gains.
Many dealers chose to pass only half of the futures' gains onto farmers, with most cash bids up 10 cents, versus the 20 and 25 cent gains in the futures.

Snow-covered or soggy fields delayed spring wheat planting from Minnesota to Montana. In Minnesota and the Dakotas, dealers said it would be mid-May before spring wheat could be sown. However, in Montana planting could begin in 10 days if no rain falls.
Farmers sold small amounts of new-crop hard red winter wheat in reaction to Monday's price gains, but concerns about planting delays discouraged them from selling new-crop spring wheat, dealers said.
